IMPORTANT_scope: These numbers are measured on the REGISTERED dataset in data/raw, which is the same data the shipped model was trained on. They are in-sample figures and therefore optimistic. They describe how well the pipeline recognises images it was built from, not how it generalises to a new photograph.

held_out_test_split.note: From a real 60/20/20 stratified run (python train.py --output-dir <dir>) on the same 150 images. The test split is never used for model selection.
